messages:
anna-product: Quick design review — pushed updated modal for the data retention + encryption flow. Link to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Main things we need resolved before dev: CTA order in the save dialog, KMS label wording, region fallback hint for compliance flows. PTAL.

sam-design: Saw the mock, nice cleanup. Two quick nits: 1) CTA order — do we keep primary on the right (Save / Cancel) or primary on the left? consistency with other consoles matters. 2) KMS label 'Customer-managed key' feels long in the compact header; can we try a short pill like `Customer key` or `BYOK` with a hover explainer?

marta-ux: For accessibility I prefer primary on the right if keyboard focus flows predictably to the first actionable element. Suggest: focus order -> first interactive = region select, then retention, then key pill, then Save. Also add `aria-describedby` on the KMS pill pointing to the hint copy. Proposed short label: 'Key ownership' + pill values 'Hosted' / 'Customer' / 'Pending'.

leo-frontend: Implementation notes: pill has 3 states (hosted/customer/pending). We also need color tokens that meet contrast. Current green used in mock (#26c281) on white is looking light. Also region dropdown: when org has region fallback rules, we currently show 'Auto (EU)' — keyboard users lose the context. Suggest showing explicit region + small fallback hint: `EU (fallback)` with a tooltip.

tim-eng: quick contrast check: #26c281 on #ffffff gives ~3.8:1, so fails WCAG AA for normal text. If we darken to #148b5c we hit >=4.5:1. I can update the design token in the components repo. For KMS pending state, add `aria-live="polite"` on the pill container so screen readers announce when a key becomes available. Also recommend a short debounce on the state transition to avoid multiple announcements.

anna-product: Copy thoughts: Audit log entries are ambiguous — 'Key rotated' doesn't tell who rotated it. Proposed copy: `KMS — customer key rotation initiated by @<user>` (shorter variant: `KMS: Customer key rotated by <user>`). Retention preset names: current names feel either too technical or scary. Proposed: 'Strict (30 days)', 'Balanced (90 days)', 'Keep indefinitely'. Prefer 'Keep indefinitely' over 'Infinite' — clearer for customers.

sam-design: +1 on 'Keep indefinitely'. For audit timestamps let's show local time as primary and include UTC offset in the tooltip (e.g., 'Mar 12, 2026 14:23 PDT (UTC-7)') — helps support teams. Also request: change BYOK badge from a lock icon to an outlined shield + key to better signal ownership vs encryption state.

deploybot: deploybot: preview deployed to staging at https://staging.redwood.example/design-previews/2027654321 — components updated, color tokens migrated. :white_check_mark:

marta-ux: I'll push the copy updates and a short a11y checklist into the Figma file: focus order, aria descriptions, color swatches, `aria-live` usage, and keyboard-only walkthrough steps. I'll also add a note on the region dropdown to include the fallback text for screen readers.

anna-product: Thanks all — can we aim to get the dev PR opened by Friday and a small release on Monday if no regressions? If we're good, I'll ping @eng-release and add the rollout notes. :pray:
